name: MOW_MAPPINGS
description: Contains mappings between work object and candidate object types.

columns.name: MAPPING_GUID
columns.description: Primary Key to uniquely identify the row

columns.name: REF_ROW_GUID
columns.description: Reference key the to respective N/D row.

columns.name: RECORD_STATUS
columns.description: Indicates if Mapping has been published to Engine

columns.name: WORKOBJ_CANDOBJ_REL_GUID
columns.description: Foreign key on the MOW_WORKOBJ_CANDOBJ_RELS.WORKOBJ_CANDOBJ_REL_GUID column.

columns.name: MAPPING_SET_GUID
columns.description: Foreign key on the MOW_MAPPING_SETS.MAPPING_SET_GUID column.

columns.name: GENERATION_TYPE
columns.description: Indicates the type of clause to be generated for this mapping.

columns.name: MAPPING_ORDER
columns.description: Indicates the sequence in which the mapping will be evaluated.

columns.name: MAPPING_OPERATOR
columns.description: Specifies which operator to use in a literal mapping clause.

columns.name: IGNORE_NULL_FLAG
columns.description: Specifies whether to ignore a dimension/attribute mapping if its value is null in work object.

columns.name: EXACT_MATCH_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates that the mapped candidate object attribute must have the exact same value as the mapped work object attribute.

columns.name: RANGE_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the mapping will support range based coverage or not.

columns.name: MAPPING_CODE
columns.description: Specifies the mapping code to use for the translation function.

columns.name: CO_ASGN_OBJECT_GUID
columns.description: Candidate Object Assignment Object Guid

columns.name: CO_ATTR_GUID1
columns.description: The first mapped Candidate Object Attribute. Foreign key on the MOW_ASGN_OBJECT_ATTRS.ASGN_OBJECT_ATTR_GUID column.

columns.name: CO_ATTR_GUID2
columns.description: The second (optional) mapped Candidate Object Attribute. Foreign key on the MOW_ASGN_OBJECT_ATTRS.ASGN_OBJECT_ATTR_GUID column.

columns.name: WO_ASGN_OBJECT_GUID
columns.description: Work Object Assignment Object Guid

columns.name: WO_ALT_ASGN_OBJECT_GUID
columns.description: Work Object Alternate Assignment Object Guid

columns.name: LITERAL_VALUE
columns.description: The literal value with which the mapped attribute (either work object or candidate object) will be compared against.

columns.name: WO_ATTR_GUID1
columns.description: The first mapped Work Object Attribute. Foreign key on the MOW_ASGN_OBJECT_ATTRS.ASGN_OBJECT_ATTR_GUID column.

columns.name: WO_ATTR_GUID2
columns.description: The second mapped Work Object Attribute. Foreign key on the MOW_ASGN_OBJECT_ATTRS.ASGN_OBJECT_ATTR_GUID column.

columns.name: WO_ALT_ATTR_GUID1
columns.description: The first alternate mapped Work Object Attribute. Foreign key on the MOW_ASGN_OBJECT_ATTRS.ASGN_OBJECT_ATTR_GUID column.

columns.name: WO_ALT_ATTR_GUID2
columns.description: The second alternate mapped Work Object Attribute. Foreign key on the MOW_ASGN_OBJECT_ATTRS.ASGN_OBJECT_ATTR_GUID column.

columns.name: FUNC_SVC_NAME
columns.description: The name of the service that will be invoked for translating the work object attribute value(s) into the candidate object attribute value(s).

columns.name: FUNC_NAME
columns.description: The name of the service method that will be invoked for translating the work object attribute value(s) into the candidate object attribute value(s).

columns.name: ANY_VALUE1
columns.description: The first "Any" value of mapping.

columns.name: ANY_VALUE2
columns.description: The second "Any" value of mapping.

columns.name: INACTIVE_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the record is active or not

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: SEED_DATA_SOURCE
columns.description: Source of seed data record. A value of 'BULK_SEED_DATA_SCRIPT' indicates that record was bulk loaded. Otherwise, specifies the name of the seed data file.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET1
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET1. Context values are Y or N.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET2
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET2. Context values are Y or N.
